pages.title: What's Next
pages.text: To reach $(t4)Tier 4$(), bank $(t4){{tier 3 threshold}}$() tokens or clear $(t4){{tier 3 rushpct}}$() of the Tier 3 bosses, ending with $(warn)Lucifer$(), the combat capstone.$(br2)$(note)The pinch:$() the boss-rush route demands Lucifer. A peaceful builder or cultivator can bank {{tier 3 threshold}} tokens instead and walk past him.
